Soft-Float Mandelbrot

Fractals · Mode 7
The Mandelbrot set in IEEE-754 single-precision float — on a CPU with no FPU, so every multiply, add and compare is a software-float libcall. The chunky image grinds in because each fat pixel is hundreds of __mulsf3/__addsf3; bit-for-bit identical to host x86. Compiler stress-test #21.
